summary: St. Joe National Forest lookout in Shoshone County: 1915 log cabin, 1919 platform tower, 1939 L-4 tower, gone by 1954; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: log cabin, then a platform tower, then an L-4 tower
facts.status_note: Gone by 1954 per two pages and a state list; no source describes what remains

access.note: Idaho Fire Lookouts files it as a hike-in site on St. Joe National Forest land

events.note: Log cabin about three-quarters of a mile west; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say a trapper built the original cabin in the 1890s
Listed as gone in 1954; no source gives a cause

evidence.supports: 1915 log cabin, 1919 platform tower, 1939 L-4 tower, gone 1954
evidence.quote: 1915: log cabin (built 1890s by trapper) 3/4 mile west. 1919: platform tower. 1939: L-4 tower. Gone 1954.

evidence.supports: trapper built the original cabin in the 1890s
evidence.quote: Original cabin was built by a trapper in the 1890’s

evidence.supports: state list marks Jug Rock as Tower Gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say a trapper built the original cabin in the 1890s, while both list the log cabin under 1915. The record keeps 1915 as the first date the cabin appears and notes the 1890s build.

notes_for_editor: Brief kind tower fits the 1939 L-4 tower, but the site first had a log cabin and a platform. All four sources are derivative of the same lookout databases, so independent confirmation is thin. Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history, so the story omits staff. No source describes the site today; the story says so. Access is hike-in per Idaho Fire Lookouts, not verified on the ground.
